description: Register a named chat pattern (regex). When a matching chat line arrives, it is emitted as a `chat:<name>` event (drain with get_events). Pass an array of patterns to register a pattern set under one name.

name.description: Pattern name; matches arrive as `chat:<name>` events

parse.description: Parse capture groups into the event payload

pattern.description: A regex source string, or an array of them for a pattern set

name: register_chat_pattern
